title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Three Typical Cases Concerning Criminal Cases of Sexual Assault Against Children
keywords_en: theft; rape; robbery; cases concerning crimes of sexual assault against children
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Publication of Three Typical Cases of Crimes of Sexual Assault Against Children

Case 1

Lü Shanjiao — rape, robbery, and theft case

(I) Basic Facts

The defendant, Lü Shanjiao, male, Han ethnicity, born on May 12, 1974, illiterate, farmer.

1. Facts concerning the rape

(1) One early morning in the winter of 2008, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, carrying tools including a dagger and a flashlight, climbed over the wall and entered the home of Xue Moumou in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. He then entered the southern room of the eastern wing, and by means of threatening with a knife, striking the head with an iron ladle found in the room, and slapping the faces, he successively raped the victims Wang A (female, aged 14 at the time) and Wang B (female, aged 17 at the time) who were in the room, and then fled the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

(2) Early on September 18, 2009, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, climbed over the wall and entered a junior middle school in Neixiang County, Henan Province. He climbed the iron gate of the female dormitory building and entered the dormitory. By means of choking the neck and threatening, he raped the victim Guo (female, aged 12 at the time), and then fled the scene.

(3) Early on October 29, 2009, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, carrying tools including a dagger and a flashlight, climbed over the wall and entered an experimental primary school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. He covered his face and entered a female dormitory. By means of threatening with a knife and choking the neck, he forcibly touched the lower body of Liu Moumou. Liu Moumou sought help from the victim Ding (female, aged 11 at the time) who shared the dormitory. Lü Shanjiao then, by means of choking the neck and slapping the face, raped Ding, and then fled the scene.

(4) Early on October 29, 2009, after committing the rape at the primary school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, climbed over the wall and entered the home of a villager named Yang Moumou, which was adjacent to the east wall of the primary school, intending to commit theft. He discovered the victim Yu (female, aged 11 at the time) sleeping in the eastern room, threatened her, raped her, and then fled the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

(5) At around 1:00 a.m. on a day in November 2009, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, carrying tools including a dagger and a flashlight, sneaked into a female dormitory on the third floor of a dormitory building of a central school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. By threatening with a knife, he forced the victim Wang (female, aged 14 at the time) to the hallway and raped her, and then fled the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

(6) At around 4:00 a.m. on January 8, 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, carrying tools including a flashlight, climbed over the wall and entered a junior middle school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. He covered his face and entered a female dormitory of the school. By means of slapping the face and choking the neck, he raped the victim Feng (female, aged 11 at the time), and then fled the scene.

(7) At around 2:00 a.m. on a day in January 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, climbed over the wall and entered a junior middle school in Neixiang County, Henan Province. He covered his face and entered a female dormitory of the school, intending to rape the victim Zhang (female, aged 15 at the time). Seeing that Zhang was extremely frightened, he abandoned the crime and left the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

(8) One early morning in March 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, climbed over the wall and entered a junior middle school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. He then entered a simple house on the west side of the school, intending to rape the victims Wang Ting (female, aged 14 at the time), Du (female, aged 14 at the time), and Wang Ke (female, aged 13 at the time). Because Wang Ting woke up and screamed loudly, Lü Shanjiao fled the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

(9) At around 2:00 a.m. on March 9, 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, climbed over the wall and entered a junior middle school in Zhenping County, Henan Province. He climbed to the second floor of the student apartment, covered his face, and entered a female dormitory. By means of slapping the face, choking the neck, and covering the mouth, he wrapped the victim Shen (female, aged 12 at the time) in a quilt and carried her to the hallway. Shen resisted and shouted. Lü Shanjiao covered Shen with the quilt and beat her, then raped her, and fled the scene. The injuries sustained by Shen constituted minor injuries.

(10) At around 3:00 a.m. on a day in January 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, carrying tools including a flashlight, climbed over the wall and entered a junior middle school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. He covered his face and entered a female dormitory. He put his hand into the bedding of the victim Liu (female, aged 13 at the time) and touched her, intending to rape her. Liu woke up and retreated to a neighboring bed. Lü Shanjiao then touched the victim Lu, but because the other girls in the dormitory woke up and shouted for help, Lü Shanjiao fled the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

(11) At around 2:00 a.m. on April 29, 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, sneaked into a female employee dormitory of a certain Co., Ltd. in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. He covered his face with a towel found in the room. By means of choking the neck and punching the face, he raped the victim Ma (female, aged 15 at the time). After checking other rooms and finding no one, he raped Ma again, and then fled the scene.

(12) One early morning in January 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, carrying tools including a dagger and a flashlight, climbed over the wall and entered a junior middle school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province. He covered his face and entered a female dormitory. By means of choking the neck and slapping the face, he attempted to rape the victim Xiong (female, aged 15 at the time). Because Xiong shouted for help and the dormitory lights were turned on, Lü Shanjiao fled the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

2. Facts concerning rape and robbery

At around 2:00 a.m. on December 26, 2009, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, carrying tools including a dagger and a flashlight, climbed over the wall and entered a secondary vocational school in Neixiang County, Henan Province. He covered his face and entered a female dormitory. By means of threatening with a knife and violent beating, he raped the victim Hao Moumou (female, aged 17 at the time), and robbed her of one Sony Ericsson bar phone (worth RMB 380), and then fled the scene. After being apprehended for other rape crimes, Lü Shanjiao voluntarily confessed to this crime.

3. Facts concerning theft

From March to June 2010, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, climbed over the wall and entered a normal school in Dengzhou City, Henan Province on three occasions. He sneaked into multiple rooms in the female dormitory building of the school and stole 11 mobile phones (worth RMB 5,070) and cash of over RMB 1,590.

In summary, the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, committed a total of 13 counts of rape, of which 9 were completed, 3 were attempted, and 1 was abandoned. He raped a total of 10 victims, of whom 5 were female children under the age of 14, and caused minor injuries to 1 victim. During the process of committing rape, he also committed 1 count of robbery, robbing one mobile phone worth RMB 380. He also committed 3 counts of theft, stealing property worth RMB 6,660.

(II) Judgment

The court held that the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, by violating the will of women and using violent and coercive means to forcibly have sexual relations with them and to rape female children under the age of 14, constituted the crime of rape. His act of using violent means to immediately take the property of others for the purpose of illegal possession constituted the crime of robbery. His act of secretly stealing a relatively large amount of property from others for the purpose of illegal possession also constituted the crime of theft. He should be punished for all crimes in accordance with the law. Lü Shanjiao committed new crimes shortly after being released from prison after serving his full sentence. Within a period of over one year, he moved from place to place, primarily targeting female students lodging at primary and secondary schools as his victims. He committed rape against underage females by violent and coercive means, committing 13 counts of rape, of which 9 were completed. He raped 10 persons, of whom 5 were female children under the age of 14, and caused minor injuries to 1 person. During the process of rape, he also committed 1 count of robbery. The nature of the crimes was especially vile, the circumstances and consequences were especially serious, and the social harm was great. He also committed 3 counts of theft, involving a relatively large amount of stolen property. He should all be punished in accordance with the law. As a recidivist, he had extremely deep subjective malice and high personal dangerousness, and should be given a heavier punishment in accordance with the law. Although Lü Shanjiao confessed to some of the rape crimes after being brought to justice, and among the rape crimes he committed, 3 were attempted and 1 was abandoned, his crimes were so serious that they were insufficient to warrant a lighter punishment. Accordingly, it was determined in accordance with the law that the defendant, Lü Shanjiao, was guilty of the crime of rape and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; guilty of the crime of robbery and sentenced to three years' imprisonment, with a fine of RMB 5,000; guilty of the crime of theft and sentenced to two years and six months' imprisonment, with a fine of RMB 5,000; and it was decided that he should be executed, with deprivation of political rights for life and a fine of RMB 10,000. After review and approval by the Supreme People's Court, the criminal Lü Shanjiao has been executed in accordance with the law.

Case 2

Gao Enjun — rape case

(I) Basic Facts

The defendant, Gao Enjun, male, Han ethnicity, born on January 13, 1974, educated to junior high school level, farmer.

After the Spring Festival in 2011, the defendant, Gao Enjun, began chatting online with Wang Moumou (victim, female, aged 13 at the time), a first-year junior high school student at XX Middle School in Changyi City, Shandong Province. In March 2011, Gao Enjun met Wang Moumou in person. To facilitate contact, Gao Enjun bought Wang Moumou a mobile phone and drove to pick her up and drop her off at school multiple times. During this period, Gao Enjun raped Wang Moumou four times in a rented house in the Limin Street Longfeng Printing and Dyeing Factory Family Courtyard in Changyi City. On March 25, 2011, Wang Moumou reported to the police that she had been raped by Gao Enjun. Afterwards, Gao Enjun voluntarily compensated Wang Moumou RMB 10,000.

(II) Judgment

The court held that the defendant, Gao Enjun, disregarding national law, had sexual relations multiple times with the female child Wang Moumou, causing significant harm to Wang Moumou's physical and psychological well-being. His actions constituted the crime of rape. Gao Enjun had cognitive abilities commensurate with his age. He knew that Wang Moumou was a junior high school student and should have known that a junior high school student like Wang Moumou was highly likely to be a female child under the age of 14. Nevertheless, he allowed his actions to occur and had sexual relations multiple times with this female student under the age of 14. His motive for raping a female child was obvious, and the facts were clear. The defendant and his defense counsel did not provide effective evidence that he genuinely did not know that Wang Moumou was under the age of 14. Therefore, his defense that he did not know the victim was a female child was not accepted. Considering that Gao Enjun showed some remorse, a lighter punishment could be given at the court's discretion. Accordingly, it was determined in accordance with the law that the defendant, Gao Enjun, was guilty of the crime of rape and sentenced to eight years' imprisonment.

Case 3

Wu Maodong — child molestation case

(I) Basic Facts

The defendant, Wu Maodong, also known as Wu Maodong, male, Han ethnicity, born on March 7, 1971, educated to associate degree level, teacher.

The defendant, Wu Maodong, was a primary school Chinese language teacher at XX School in Nanshan District, Shenzhen City. From November 2012 to May 23, 2013, Wu Maodong took advantage of the opportunity to supervise students during their noon break in the classroom from Monday to Friday. On multiple occasions, he called the female student victims Z, C, and H (aged 7 at the time), who assisted him in maintaining order during the noon break, to the podium. By means of coaxing, deceiving, and threatening, he inserted his hand into their clothing and touched their sensitive areas, thereby committing acts of molestation. Wu Maodong also, on multiple occasions after school on Fridays when no one was around, molested the victim L (aged 8 at the time) by kissing her face. After committing the above molestation acts, Wu Maodong coaxed the victims not to tell their parents. At noon on May 23, Wu Maodong again molested the victim C using the same method. On May 26, C's parents discovered abnormal behavior in their child. After learning the circumstances from other victims, they reported the matter to the public security organ on May 27.

(II) Judgment

The court held that the defendant, Wu Maodong, committed child molestation in a public place and in the presence of others, and his actions constituted the crime of child molestation. The place where Wu Maodong molested the victims was in the classroom. The time when he committed the molestation was at noon. There were still some students taking a nap in the classroom at that time, and some students had discovered his molestation acts. Therefore, these molestations should be characterized as "in a public place and in the presence of others" for the purpose of child molestation. Wu Maodong, on multiple occasions after school when no one was around, kissed the face of the victim L and coaxed her not to tell others, especially not her parents. This indicated that he had the subjective intent to molest, which was not the natural expression of affection of an ordinary adult towards a child. It should be characterized as an act of molestation. However, this act of molestation occurred after school when no one was in the classroom, and should be distinguished from Wu Maodong's acts of molesting other victims in the classroom during the noon break in the presence of others. Wu Maodong, as a teacher, should have been a model of teaching, educating, and abiding by the law. However, he took advantage of his identity as a teacher to repeatedly molest multiple primary school students over a relatively long period. The nature of his conduct was vile, and the social impact was extremely negative. He betrayed the respect and trust of students and parents towards teachers, not only causing psychological trauma to the young victims and their families, but also seriously damaging the image of teachers. He should be given a heavier punishment. Wu Maodong truthfully confessed his crimes and pleaded guilty in court, so a lighter punishment could be given at the court's discretion. Accordingly, considering the circumstances of the defendant's crime, the social harmfulness, and his attitude of admitting guilt, it was determined in accordance with the law that Wu Maodong was guilty of the crime of child molestation and sentenced to eight years' imprisonment.
